source: #0 Yikes! A monster?!
comment: あ、あれって魔獣…！？

source: #1 Huh... Never seen this kind before.
comment: ふむ、見たことのない種類だが。

source: #2 It looks like a Flying Feline.\n Careful, everyone.
comment: トビネコだな…\n 気を引き締めていこう。

source: #3 Please tell me there aren't more of\n those things lurking around here...
comment: うう…今みたいなのが\n 何匹もうろついてるのかな…

source: #4 I hate to tell you, but I can sense\n more further in.
comment: 気配を感じる…\n 間違いなさそうだ。

source: #5 Anyway, let's just stay alert.
comment: とにかく、焦らず先に進もう。

source: #6 I'm starting to lose my sense\n of direction down here...
comment: 本当に地下道って感じだよね…\n 方向感覚がなくなってきたかも…

source: #7 Yeah. Gotta make sure we're\n not going in circles.
comment: ああ、気をつけて進まないとな。

source: #8 What's a place like this even\n doing on the school grounds?
comment: しかし、どうして学院の敷地に\n こんな場所があるんだ？

source: #9 Yeah... Who puts a giant trap\n door in a campus building?
comment: そうだよねぇ…\n 落とし穴まで用意してるし。

source: #10 Looks like the path splits. Which\n way do you think we should go?
comment: 分かれ道か…\n どちらに行ったものかな。

source: #11 I feel a little wind blowing from the\n east. I'd bet the exit's that way.
comment: 風を感じる…出口は東側のようだ。

source: #13 (He seems kinda...imposing. I don't\n know how to break the ice...)
comment: （う、うーん…話しかけづらいかも…）

source: #15 (He seems kinda...imposing. I don't\n know how to break the ice...)
comment: （う、うーん…話しかけづらいかも…）

source: #16 Bah... I feel like we've just\n been going in circles.
comment: くっ…さっきから同じ場所を\n 歩き続けている気がするぞ…

source: #17 You might be right. Maybe we should\n check where we are on the map.
comment: ああ…いったん地図で\n 位置を確認した方がよさそうだ。

source: #18 I feel like we've simply\n been running in circles.
comment: チッ…さっきから同じ場所を\n 歩き続けているようだな。

source: #19 You might be right. Maybe we should\n check where we are on the map.
comment: ああ…いったん地図で\n 位置を確認した方がよさそうだ。

source: #20 Wow, check out all these stalls!
comment: あはは、色んな屋台があって\n 目移りしちゃうね。

source: #21 Oooh. The lace at that stall\n has a really pretty design.
comment: うーん、今のレース、\n すごく良い柄だったわね。

source: #22 Mishy...? I admit, it has a certain charm.
comment: みっしぃ…？\n 妙に心惹かれる造形だな。

source: #23 All these windmills sure make\n the town feel pretty laid back.
comment: 風車がたくさん…\n ふふっ、のどかでいいわね。

source: #24 True. The scenery is surprisingly\n relaxing.
comment: うん、癒される光景だな。

source: #25 This would be a really tranquil\n area...if not for the monsters.
comment: こっちものどかだね…\n やっぱり魔獣はいるみたいだけど。

source: #26 Yeah. Let's be careful.
comment: まあ、気をつけて行こう。

source: #27 Is this a farmhouse?
comment: ここは…農家のようだな。

source: #28 Huh. I wonder where we are...
comment: あれ、なんだろう、ここ…

source: #29 Hmm... It says,\n 'Lunaria Nature Park.'
comment: ふむ、『ルナリア自然公園』\n と書かれているようだが。

source: #30 Wow. This farmhouse is huge.
comment: へえ…大きな農家ね。

source: #31 Haha. Look at the cows! ♪
comment: あはは、牛がいるよ♪

source: #32 The Transcontinental Railroad, huh?\n Guess that'll take you out of the country.
comment: 大陸横断鉄道…\n 外国に通じているんだったな。

source: #33 Yeah. If you keep on heading east, you'd\n eventually reach Garrelia Fortress.
comment: ええ…このずっと先に\n 東の国境、ガレリア要塞があるわ。

source: #34 We should take a right here\n to reach the nature park.
comment: 自然公園は、ここを右手だな。

source: #35 Right. Let's go!
comment: ええ、行ってみましょう…！

source: #36 There's tons of little stone\n monuments in here...
comment: なんか、小さな石碑が\n あちこちにあるけど…

source: #37 Yeah. What do you think\n they're supposed to be?
comment: ええ…何なのかしら？

source: #38 I imagine they were made by\n the animists in this province.
comment: 多分、この地方にあった\n 精霊信仰の名残だろう。

source: #39 This way's a dead end.
comment: こちらは行き止まりか。

source: #40 Yeah... This park covers a lot\n more area than I was expecting.
comment: ああ…思った以上に\n 奥深いみたいだな。

source: #41 Oh, there's a stream here.\n This seems like a nice spot.
comment: 小川か…少しほっとするわね。

source: #42 I can't sense anyone in this area.
comment: この辺りに\n 人の気配はないようだ。

source: #43 Just how deep does this forest go?
comment: こ、この森、\n どこまで続いてるのかな…

source: #44 We must be pretty far in now.\n I'd imagine we're almost there.
comment: かなり進んだはずだ。\n あと一息だろう。

source: #45 Oh, hey! There's an orbment\n charging station!
comment: あっ…！\n 回復装置があるわ…！

source: #46 We must be in the most remote\n reaches of the park.
comment: ああ…どうやら終点みたいだ。

source: #47 Who's this a statue of?
comment: この像、ナニ？

source: #48 It seems to be a statue\n of St. Veronica.
comment: 聖女ヴェロニカの像、\n みたいですね。

source: #49 Oh? You know of her?
comment: ほう、詳しいな。

source: #50 *sigh* I love the look of this\n city. It's so beautiful...
comment: はぁ…\n 本当に綺麗な街並みですね。

source: #51 Maybe so, but it's got nothing on\n Heimdallr in terms of sheer scale.
comment: フン…規模は帝都の方が\n はるかに上だがな。

source: #52 Is this the way to\n the city's airport?
comment: この先は…\n 飛行船の発着場みたいだな。

source: #53 It is, though I doubt we'll have\n any reason to go there.
comment: ああ、今回は用はあるまい。

source: #54 This seems to be the city's noble quarter.
comment: この辺りは…貴族の方々が\n 住んでいるみたいですね。

source: #55 No wonder most of these houses\n look so overblown and excessive.
comment: フン、どうりでお高く止まった\n 屋敷が多いわけだ。

source: #57 Wait, this leads to...
comment: おい、そちらは…

source: #58 Huh? What's wrong?
comment: ？ どうしたんだ？

source: #59 ...Never mind.
comment: …いや、何でもない。

source: #60 This street seems kinda\n different from the others.
comment: ここ、ちょっと雰囲気違うね。

source: #61 This is Artisans' Street, where craftsmen\n and merchants ply their trades.
comment: 職人通り…\n 様々な店が軒を連ねているな。

source: #62 Oh, a lake.
comment: あ、池がある。

source: #63 Heehee. It looks so pretty.
comment: ふふっ、綺麗ですね。

source: #64 A bridge, huh?
comment: この橋は…

source: #65 Saar Bridge. Beyond here is out\n of bounds for our field study.
comment: ザール橋…\n 実習範囲はここまでだ。

source: #66 That bridge above us looks like it\n dates back to the Middle Ages.
comment: 上にあるのは…\n 中世の橋梁みたいだな。

source: #67 It is. It's been there for\n several hundred years.
comment: ああ、数百年前のものだ。

source: #68 This looks like quite an old road,\n though it does seem well reinforced.
comment: 古い道みたいですけど…\n かなり補強がされていますね。

source: #69 Yup... Looks like a lot of\n armored vehicles come this way.
comment: ん…車両も結構通ってるみたい。

source: #71 I didn't notice there was a path here...
comment: こんな所に道が…

source: #72 The monster we're looking\n for should be just ahead.
comment: 手配された魔獣は\n この先みたいだな。

source: #73 We're finally back.
comment: やっと戻って来た。

source: #74 Whew... My feet are killing me.
comment: ふぅ…\n さすがに歩き疲れましたね。

source: #75 Just the kind of thing you'd\n expect in an old ruin like this.
comment: いかにも中世の遺跡っぽい\n ギミックだね。

source: #76 Do you think it's powered by\n the water flowing through here?
comment: ええ、水の力を\n 使ってるんでしょうか。

source: #77 The entrance to the guardhouse is\n to the west. We should hurry.
comment: 領邦軍の詰所は西だ。\n …とにかく急ぐぞ。

source: #78 *pant* Why is this ladder so long?
comment: ふぅふぅ…\n ずいぶん長い梯子ですね。

source: #79 Is it harder to climb ladders\n when you've got a big chest?
comment: やっぱり胸が大きいと\n 登りにくい？
フィ、フィーちゃん…///

source: #82 There's another lattice door...
comment: また格子扉か…

source: #83 There should be a mechanism\n to open it somewhere nearby.
comment: 近くの仕掛けで開くはずだ。\n 探してみるぞ。

source: #84 Whew... I'm exhausted...
comment: はぁ…ちょっと疲れました。

source: #85 It's gotta be the chest...
comment: やっぱり胸が…

source: #86 Fie, that's enough.
comment: フィー。\n そのくらいにしなさい。

source: #87 ...Honestly.
comment: …まったく。

source: #88 Ugh. If I hadn't been so careless,\n this would never have happened...
comment: クッ、しかし油断しなければ\n こんな事態には…

source: #89 There wasn't much you could've done.
comment: あの場合は仕方ないさ。

source: #90 Heehee. I'm just glad you're all right.
comment: ふふっ…\n とにかく無事で良かったです。

source: #91 That's the wrong way...!
comment: そっちは違う…！

source: #92 We need to head east! Hurry!
comment: 東へまっすぐだ、急ぐぞ！

source: #93 Yoohoo!
comment: やっほ──…っ！

source: #94 Heehee. You're as excited as a child.
comment: ふふっ、アリサさん、\n 子供みたい。

source: #95 Ahaha. I think I'm just\n caught up in the moment.
comment: あはは、ちょっと\n ハイになってるみたい。

source: #96 The sun's almost down...
comment: 日が落ちてきたな…

source: #97 We're almost at the settlement.\n Let's keep up the pace, guys.
comment: 集落までもう少しだ。\n このまま飛ばすとしよう。

source: #98 Heehee. Look at all the sheep here.
comment: ふふっ…\n 羊がたくさんですね。

source: #99 Watching them makes me feel so...content.
comment: うーん、癒されるわね。

source: #100 You have an orbal truck here?
comment: へえ、導力車も\n 使っているんだな？

source: #101 Looks like an old-model Reinford truck.
comment: ラインフォルト製の\n 古い運搬車みたいだけど…

source: #102 Yup. It was donated to the\n settlement a few years ago.
comment: 数年前、とある人が\n 寄贈してくれたものでな。

source: #103 I'm surprised to see a river\n running at this elevation.
comment: ほう…こんな高地にも\n 川が流れているのか。

source: #104 It's fed from the lake to the north.
comment: ああ、北にある湖から\n 流れてきたものだ。

source: #105 I figured there'd be monsters\n around. Be careful, everyone.
comment: やはり魔獣が出ている…\n 気をつけて行くとしよう。

source: #106 Got it.
comment: ああ、了解だ…！

source: #107 Umm... Isn't this the way to...?
comment: えっと、こちらの方って…

source: #108 This path leads to the stone\n circle you saw yesterday.
comment: このまま道沿いに回ると\n 昨日の石柱群にたどり着くな。

source: #109 Is this the way to the watchtower?
comment: 監視塔とやらはこの先か。

source: #110 Yeah. Just keep heading along this path.
comment: ああ、このまま\n 道沿いに行けばいい。

source: #111 Well...here we are...
comment: や、やっと門に着いたわね…

source: #112 Let's go meet with the\n lieutenant general.
comment: ああ…\n 中将から話を聞いてみよう。
あれが…

source: #114 It looks like a Calvard military base.
comment: 共和国軍の基地みたいですね…

source: #115 It is. This area kind of acts as a\n buffer zone between the two countries.
comment: ああ…ちょうどこの辺りが\n 緩衝地帯になっているらしい。

source: #116 There's mist in the distance...
comment: モヤが立っているな…

source: #117 Yeah. It's even higher here\n than the southern highlands.
comment: ああ、南よりも\n さらに高地なんだろう。

source: #118 Wow... That's one towering waterfall.
comment: わぁ…あの滝、\n 凄い高さから落ちてるわね。

source: #119 I'll say. It must be at\n least a 500 arge drop.
comment: ええ、５００アージュくらい\n 落差がありそうですね…

source: #120 Oh, it's a plateau. I guess\n this way's a dead end.
comment: 高台か…\n こちらは行き止まりだな。

source: #121 Ahhh... I love how refreshing\n the wind feels here.
comment: ふふっ、風が気持ちいいですね。

source: #122 Oh... We made it all the way\n to where the giant statue is.
comment: あ…像の正面に来たわね。

source: #123 It looks even more massive\n the closer we get.
comment: ああ、それにしても大きいな…

source: #124 To get right in front of it, we'll\n need to go around the cliff.
comment: 像の前に行くには\n 左右から回り込む必要があるな。

source: #125 I'm glad to be back here again.
comment: ふぅ…ホッとしますね。

source: #126 Agreed. I'm certainly\n in no hurry to return.
comment: フン…\n 辛気臭い場所だったな。

source: #127 How beautiful...
#128 Yeah... Breathtaking.
comment: 素敵な場所ですね…

source: #129 Man, I'd love to get in\n a little fishing here.
comment: うーん…\n 釣りがしたくなるな。

source: #130 Well, no one's stopping you.
comment: 別に止めはしないぞ。

source: #131 This is...
comment: ここは…

source: #132 It's so gloomy in here...
comment: な、なんか薄暗いわね…

source: #134 That's one of the Imperial\n Army's airships...
comment: 帝国軍が運用している\n 軍用飛行艇だわ…

source: #135 This situation is looking\n worse by the minute.
comment: フン、思った以上に\n キナ臭くなっているな。

source: #136 ...We need to hurry.
comment: …とにかく急ぐぞ。

source: #137 Those are armored cars\n from the Imperial Army...!
comment: 帝国軍の導力装甲車…！

source: #138 Damn... This isn't looking good...
comment: クッ、このままじゃ…

source: #140 We can't let them get away!
comment: このまま行かせるものか…！

source: #141 Right! We need to overtake them!
comment: ああ！\n 何としても追いつこう！

source: #142 Crap... They're fast!
comment: くっ、速い…！

source: #143 Just don't lose sight of them!
comment: ともかく見失うな…！

source: #144 Did they touch down near\n the stone circle...?
comment: せ、石柱群のあたりに\n 降りたんでしょうか…！？

source: #145 Grrr... There's no escape for them now!
comment: くうう～…\n 絶対に追いつくわよっ！

source: #146 Woohoooooo! This is amaaaziiiiiing!
comment: ひゃっほう！\n あはは、気持ちいーね！

source: #147 *sigh* If you keep squirming around\n back there, you're going to fall off.
comment: はあ…あんまりはしゃいで\n 落ちないようにな？

source: #148 Mmm... If we keep up this pace,\n we might make it in time after all.
comment: うーん、この速度なら\n 何とか間に合いそうかな？

source: #149 Not might. We WILL make it in time.
comment: ああ…\n 必ず間に合わせてみせる！

source: #150 The ancient quarry is this way, right?
comment: 石切り場…この先ね。

source: #151 Yup. Just 'round the back of this statue!
comment: うん、この像の裏手だよ～！

source: #152 What are those glowing things, anyway?
comment: それにしても…\n なに、あの光ってるの…？

source: #153 I'm actually rather curious, myself.
comment: ええ…\n ちょっと気になりますね。

source: #154 A-hem!
comment: ──えっへん！

source: #155 How does that thing even WORK?
comment: まったく…\n どういうカラクリだ。

source: #156 That one's huge... What do you\n think they could be?
comment: 大きいな…本当に何なんだ？

source: #157 I don't know, but we'd better\n exercise a little caution.
comment: 判らん──だが、\n 気を付けた方がよさそうだ。

source: #158 Oh, we're back outside.
comment: あ、外に出たね。

source: #159 Ahhh... It's nice to be back\n in the great outdoors again.
comment: ふう…\n 少しホッとするわね。

source: #160 Ah, isn't this...?
comment: おや、この建物は…

source: #161 Oh, this is where they publish the\n Imperial Chronicle newspaper.
comment: 《帝国時報》──\n おなじみの新聞社だね。

source: #162 So this is the opera house, huh?\n Might be nice to see a show sometime.
comment: オペラハウスか…\n ちょっと興味あるな。

source: #163 You need to reserve your seats\n two months in advance, though.
comment: 入りたいのなら２ヶ月前から\n 予約する必要があるぞ。

source: #164 ...And that's just for the cheap seats!
comment: それでもＢ席だもんねぇ。

source: #165 Wow. A tiara encrusted with carnelians?\n This is about as ritzy as you can get.
comment: 紅耀石のティアラか…\n かなりの品みたいだな。

source: #166 It's so shiny...
comment: ん…キラキラしてる。

source: #167 Here's the statue of Emperor Dreichels.\n He strikes quite a stately pose.
comment: 獅子心皇帝…\n 威風堂々としたお姿だな。

source: #168 Weird to think he's the one\n who founded our academy.
comment: ああ、俺たちにとっても\n 縁のある人なんだよな。

source: #169 Hmm... Looks like we've hit a dead end.
comment: ふむ…こちらは行き止まりか。

source: #170 This area seems easy to get lost in.
comment: うーん、土地勘がないと\n 迷いそうだな。

source: #171 That's three cats now.
comment: ネコ、これで３匹目。

source: #172 Ahaha. What a little cutie.
comment: あはは、可愛かったね。

source: #173 There have always been a lot of cats\n around here. Not sure why, though.
comment: …この辺りは\n なぜか猫が多いんだ。

source: #174 This would make a great training area.\n I envy the people who live around here.
comment: ふむ、中々良い修行場所だ。\n 帝都民がうらやましいぞ。

source: #175 ...Only YOU would see an underground\n passage and think about training.
comment: そんな感想を抱くのは\n 間違いなく君くらいだぞ…

source: #176 There's a light...
comment: 明かりが見えた。

source: #177 The sound's getting louder, too.
comment: 音も大きくなってる…

source: #178 We must be getting\n close to the exit now.
comment: 出口が近いみたいだな。

source: #179 Ahhh... What a pleasant evening.
comment: ふふ、良い夜だな。

source: #180 It's pretty relaxing.
comment: ん…落ち着く。

source: #181 (No denying those two have\n some surprising similarities...)
comment: （やっぱりこの２人、\n  元々気が合うんだな…）

source: #182 Being near water always helps me relax.
comment: フフ…\n やはり水辺は落ち着くな。

source: #183 Oh, yeah. Your hometown is right\n on a lake, isn't it?
comment: そういえば、ラウラの故郷は\n 湖に面してるんだったか。

source: #184 Esperanza?
comment: “えすぺらんさ”…？

source: #185 I believe it means 'hope.'
comment: たしか“希望”という意味だな。

source: #186 This park is so peaceful, it's easy\n to forget we're in the capital.
comment: のどかだな…\n 帝都にあるとは思えぬくらいだ。

source: #187 I could take a nap here.
comment: 昼寝したいかも。

source: #188 Ahaha. Yeah. People love to\n come here to relax.
comment: あはは、一応、\n 帝都市民の憩いの場所だからね。

source: #189 *sigh* Just coming here reminds\n me of last night's ordeal.
comment: はあ…昨夜は散々だった。

source: #190 Sounds like you had a rough night.
comment: あはは…ご愁傷さま。

source: #191 There are so many butterflies.
comment: 蝶、結構いるね。

source: #192 It really gives the place an\n exotic touch, huh?
comment: ああ、ちょっと\n 異国情緒があるな。

source: #193 I wonder when that mechanism was made...
comment: こういう仕掛けって、\n 何時ごろ造られたのかな？

source: #194 I'm guessing a few hundred years ago\n at least. Probably during the Dark Ages.
comment: たぶん数百年前…\n 中世の暗黒時代じゃないか？

source: #195 Those were difficult times back then.
comment: ふむ、戦乱の時代だな。

source: #196 This area's full of water...
comment: 水が溜まってるね…

source: #197 I'll bet there's some way\n to drain it.
comment: ああ、どうしたもんかな。

source: #198 Let's have a look around, then.
comment: 周りを調べてみるしか。

source: #199 This place seems like it goes\n on forever...
comment: そ、それにしても\n とんでもなく広いよね…

source: #200 My father sure gave us a real\n humdinger of a job to deal with.
comment: ああ…父さんめ、\n 厄介ごとを押し付けたな。

source: #201 Well, I'm sure we must be\n getting close now.
comment: はは…\n まあ、あと少しだろう。

source: #202 Oh, there's the exit.
comment: あ、出口だ。

source: #203 Haha. We're finally there.
comment: フフ、やれやれだな。

source: #204 Sure are more people out than\n there were yesterday.
comment: しかし昨日よりも\n ずいぶん人出が多いな…

source: #205 They must've all come to see\n the Imperial family's parade.
comment: あはは、皇族の方々の\n パレード目当てだろうね。

source: #206 Grr... Those damn terrorists...
comment: くっ、テロリストめ…

source: #207 (Elise... Princess Alfin...\n Please be safe!)
comment: （エリゼ、皇女殿下も…\n  無事でいてくれ…！）

source: #208 Monsters!
comment: 魔獣がいる…！

source: #209 No problem. We'll just\n cut our way through!
comment: 問題ない…！\n このまま蹴散らすぞ！
Ｊａ（ヤー）。

source: #211 This is Lake Ebel, right? It's even\n bigger than I thought it'd be!
comment: エベル湖だっけー。\n けっこう広そうな湖だよね。

source: #212 It's quite large. If the mist would\n clear, you could get a better view.
comment: うむ、今日はあいにく\n 霧が出てよく見えぬが。

source: #213 A cross inside a circle...\n Any idea what it means?
comment: 円に十字か…\n どんな意味があるんだ？

source: #214 No one really knows for sure. There\n are a number of theories, though.
comment: さて…諸説はあるが\n どれも定かでないらしい。

source: #215 Unfortunately, the meanings of most\n animist symbols have been lost over time.
comment: 精霊信仰におけるシンボルの意味は\n 殆ど喪われているそうですから…

source: #216 You've got a wharf here?
comment: このあたりは、船着場か？

source: #217 We do. A ferry makes trips between\n here and the opposite shore.
comment: うむ、対岸にある波止場と\n 定期船が行き来しているな。

source: #218 If you crossed the lake, you'd be\n in the Sutherland province, right?
comment: 対岸というと…\n サザーラント州になるのか。

source: #219 This building is the Legram\n branch of the Bracer Guild.
comment: この建物が、遊撃士協会、\n レグラム支部になる。

source: #220 Wow. I didn't think that door\n led out here.
comment: へー、こんな所に出られるんだー。

source: #221 Haha. Nice find.
comment: はは、穴場かもしれないな。

source: #222 It feels almost...magical.
comment: しかし…幻想的な光景だな。

source: #223 I know. Like if you just wait long enough,\n you might see a fairy or something.
comment: そうですね…\n 本当に妖精とか現れそうです。

source: #224 Oh, the train comes through here!
comment: あ、線路があるよ！

source: #225 That's the Ebel Branch Line--the\n same line we traveled here on.
comment: エベル支線…\n 俺たちが通ってきた路線か。

source: #226 Oh, wow. There's a river out here.
comment: へえ、川が流れているのか。

source: #227 Haha. I remember playing in\n this river when I was young.
comment: フフ、幼い頃はあそこで\n よく水遊びをしたものだ。

source: #228 Oooh, there's a boat on the wharf!
comment: あー、船が来てるよ！

source: #229 That's the ferry liner. It returns\n to the wharf every evening.
comment: 水上定期船だ。\n 夕方にはこちらに戻ってくる。

source: #230 Ahhh. It's so cool here, you'd\n hardly believe it's summer.
comment: はー、夏なのに涼しいね～。

source: #231 The weather's pleasant today.\n A fine wind blowing, too.
comment: 天気もいいし、\n 良い風が吹いているな。

source: #232 Strutting around another lord's\n territory... How pompous can you get?
comment: 気に喰わんな…\n よその領地で我が物顔とは。

source: #233 It sounds like there's a real VIP here...
comment: かなりの地位の方が\n いらしているようですが…

source: #234 ...Well, let's return to the manor\n for now.
comment: …まあ、ともかく戻るとしよう。

source: #235 So this is St. Sandlot's old\n stronghold, Lohengrin Castle...
comment: ローエングリン城…\n 救国の聖女の古城か。

source: #236 This is the first time I've come here\n at night. Be careful of your footing.
comment: 私も夜に来るのは初めてだ。\n 足元に気をつけるがいい。

source: #237 Whoa! What's that?
comment: ほえ、あれって…

source: #238 Something's strange about the castle...
comment: 城の外壁のようだが…

source: #239 Is that glow just the moonlight?
comment: 月明かりで\n 光っているのか…？

source: #240 This castle has no shortage of strange\n foes. Perhaps they really ARE gho--
comment: 妙な連中ばかりだな。\n フン、やはり幽──

source: #241 D-Don't say it!
comment: い、言っちゃだめーっ！！

source: #242 You need a 'key' to dispel a barrier\n like this. We should start looking.
comment: この種の結界には“鍵”があるはず。\n …それらしい物を探してみましょう。

source: #243 An external corridor. We must be\n on the north side of the castle.
comment: 外回廊…\n 城の北側になるみたいだな。

source: #244 We've gone pretty far inside now.\n I hope the children are safe...
comment: かなり奥まで来たはずだ。\n 子供たちが無事だといいが…

source: #245 Oh, another barrier. Let's see if we\n can find the orb that dispels it.
comment: あ…また結界ですね。\n 対応する宝珠を探しましょう。

source: #246 (This all seems strangely\n ...normal to her.)
comment: （委員長、妙に手際がいいな…）

source: #247 Left hand, right hand,\n left hand, right hand...
comment: うんしょ、うんしょ…

source: #248 Tch... Nothing but trouble.
comment: フン、面倒だな。

source: #249 This looks like...
comment: ここが…

source: #250 We've reached the uppermost floor.\n The bell tower is ahead.
comment: 城の最上階…\n この先に鐘楼がある。

source: #251 The energy's source is\n nearby... Almost there!
comment: 気配が近い…\n 行ってみましょう！

source: #252 What the...?!
comment: これは…！

source: #253 Looks like they were packing explosive\n charges. We'll need to find another route!
comment: 爆発物で破壊したみたいね。\n …他のルートを探すわよ！

source: #254 It seems this is a storage area.
comment: ここは倉庫区画か…

source: #255 Plenty of archaisms wandering\n around here, too.
comment: やっぱり人形兵器が\n 徘徊しているみたいだねー。

source: #256 We finally got around to the other side.
comment: 破壊されたゲートの向こうに\n 来たようだな。

source: #257 The path to the right leads deeper\n into the fort. Let's keep moving.
comment: 要塞の奥は右手か…\n このまま進むとしよう。

source: #258 Oooh, an orbment charging station!
comment: あ、回復装置だ♪

source: #259 That door near it looks\n like it leads outside...
comment: 外への出口も\n あるみたいですけど…

source: #260 Probably an external corridor.\n Everyone, follow me!
comment: たぶん外回廊ね…\n みんな、付いてきなさい！

source: #261 Hmph. Another storage area.
comment: フン、また別の倉庫区画か。

source: #262 Hmm... Looks like we hang a\n left if we wanna go through.
comment: えーと、左手に向かえば\n エリアを抜けられるみたい。

source: #263 This is the freight platform... We\n finally made it to the other side.
comment: 貨物用のホーム…\n 反対側にたどり着きましたね。

source: #264 We've gotta be close. Just need to\n head up that staircase over there!
comment: ゴールは近いわね。\n …そこの階段を登るわよ！

source: #265 (ARCUS ringing)
comment: （プルルル…プルルル…）

source: #266 Sara here... Yeah. We're almost to\n the railway gun.
comment: こちらサラ──ええ、もう少しで\n 列車砲の格納庫に到達します。

source: #267 Yeah. May Aidios be with us both.
comment: お互い女神の加護を…！

source: #268 Is Group B almost there?
comment: あちらも大詰めですか…

source: #269 This is it, so get ready!
comment: ええ…\n こっちも気合を入れるわよ！

source: #270 Right!
comment: はいっ…！

source: #271 *sigh* Master Rean, please\n don't cause too much trouble.
comment: ふう…リィン様。\n あまり困らせないで下さいませ。

source: #272 Let's make our way to the\n Reinford headquarters.
comment: ＲＦ本社ビルに参りましょう。

source: #273 Uh... Right. Of course.\n (...Why is she singling ME out?)
comment: りょ、了解です。\n （って、俺だけのせいなのか？）

source: #274 M a s t e r R e a n?
comment: リ・ィ・ン・様…？

source: #275 I-I'm sorry. (That'll give me\n nightmares...)
comment: す、すみません。\n （…笑顔が怖い…）

source: #276 (Sweet dreams.)
comment: （バッカ、むしろご褒美じゃねぇか。）

source: #277 This way leads to Marquis\n Rogner's mansion.
comment: その先は…\n ログナー侯爵家の敷地ね。

source: #278 So that's where Gelica's stubborn\n old man lives, huh? Better stay away.
comment: ゼリカの堅物オヤジか。\n 会いたくねーなぁ。

source: #279 These things sure are convenient.
comment: うーん…結構便利かも。

source: #280 I know, right? I can see them building\n some in Heimdallr eventually.
comment: ああ、帝都でも\n いずれ導入されそうだ。

source: #281 Wh-Why are you going the wrong\n way? Just because you can?
comment: な、なんでわざわざ\n 逆走するのよ？

source: #282 It's kinda fun.
comment: ちょっと楽しいかも。

source: #283 Plain old stairs just wouldn't cut it,\n for the famed industrial metropolis, huh?
comment: 街中にこんなものまで…\n つくづく機械の街という感じだな。

source: #284 Yeah... For better or worse,\n this is a town full of tech.
comment: そうね…\n 良きにつけ、悪しきにつけだけど。

source: #285 Looks like a dead end.
comment: ん、行き止まりみたい。

source: #286 This was...some kind of\n maintenance room, I think?
comment: ここは…メンテナンス用の\n 整備室だったかしら。

source: #287 Wow. You can get a great view of\n the Reinford building from here.
comment: うわ～、ここからだと\n ＲＦビルがよく見えるね。

source: #288 ...And a really sore neck.
comment: …見てたら首が凝りそう。

source: #289 Oh, yeah. This road leads all the way\n to your hometown, doesn't it, Rean?
comment: そういえば、この道って\n リィンの故郷に通じてるんだよね？

source: #290 Yeah. It'd take you days to get there\n if you tried to walk it, though.
comment: ああ、と言っても\n 徒歩だと数日はかかると思うぞ。

source: #291 Huh. This is a pretty nice area.
comment: へえ、いい場所だな。

source: #292 Grandfather used to love coming here\n to fish, now that I think about it.
comment: そういえば、お祖父様が\n よくここに釣りに来てたわね。

source: #293 You can always count on provincial\n army soldiers to be arrogant as hell.
comment: 領邦軍…\n 相変わらず横柄な連中だな。

source: #294 Hmm... Wonder what they're\n doing out here.
comment: んー…何かあんのかねぇ？

source: #295 Wow! You can see all of Roer\n spread out from here.
comment: へえ、ここからだと\n ルーレ市が一望できるな。

source: #296 You can...though the view isn't as\n nice as it'd be from the front.
comment: ええ、街の裏手だから\n 見栄えはあまりよくないけど。

source: #297 ...This is a pretty nice view.
comment: …ちょっと良い眺めかも。

source: #298 Oooh... Actually, I didn't even\n know about this place.
comment: へえ…\n こんな場所があったのね。

source: #299 Oh, a train track.
comment: あ、線路がある。

source: #300 That's the freight line that\n runs into the mine.
comment: 鉄鉱山に通じる貨物路線ね。

source: #301 *pant* I'm gonna need a rest\n before we even get there.
comment: はあはあ…\n ちょっと疲れてきたかも。

source: #302 Yeah... I wasn't expecting\n this path to be so steep.
comment: あ、ああ…\n 意外と険しい道だな。

source: #303 Man, you city slickers need to\n toughen up! Left, right, left, right!
comment: 都会っ子はだらしねえなぁ。\n ほれ、おいっちに、おいっちに！

source: #304 What was that...?
comment: なんだ……？

source: #305 By the way, did you happen to\n run into Sharon on your way out?
comment: そういや、出る時に\n シャロンさんに見つからなかったか？

source: #306 She saw me leaving, but she just\n let me go.
comment: ん、気付かれたけど\n 見逃してくれたっぽい。

source: #307 Hmm... (Even the best maids\n aren't THAT all-knowing...)
comment: そ、そうか……\n （本当、何者なんだろう。）

source: #308 This is where Claire said\n to meet her, right?
comment: 大尉さんの指定、ここだっけ。

source: #309 Yeah. This looks like the place.
comment: ああ、そのはずだ。

source: #310 (...They seem oddly cautious.)
comment: （…妙に警戒してるね。）

source: #311 (Yeah... I wonder if it has\n something to do with the RMP.)
comment: （ああ…鉄道憲兵隊絡みか？）

source: #312 This was some kind of\n classy bar, I think?
comment: ここは…\n たしか飲み屋だったか。

source: #313 Seems pretty lively in there.
comment: 賑わってるみたい。

source: #314 Wow. This city's got a nice\n feel at night.
comment: へえ…\n 夜だと雰囲気あるな。

source: #315 Yeah... It's really pretty.
comment: ん…すごく綺麗かも。

source: #316 Argh. Every minute we spend here, things\n are getting worse for the miners.
comment: くっ、こうしている間にも\n 鉄鉱山の人たちが…

source: #317 Stay calm, Alisa.
comment: アリサ、焦りは禁物。

source: #318 Yeah. The Railway Military Police\n are on their way, after all.
comment: そうだね…\n 鉄道憲兵隊も急行してるし。

source: #319 Let's at least try and get\n a look at what's going on.
comment: とにかく、様子だけでも\n 確かめに行ってみよう。

source: #320 But man, if terrorists really were\n planning to blow up the mine...
comment: しっかし、テロリストがこのまま\n 鉄鉱山を爆破でもしやがったら…

source: #321 It would shake the very\n foundations of the Empire.
comment: …帝国そのものの屋台骨が\n 揺らぎかねませんね。

source: #323 Hmm... Looks like this is just\n a one-way path.
comment: ふむ、どうやらここは\n 基本的に一本道のようだね。

source: #324 Well, no chance of us getting lost in\n here, at least. Let's run on through.
comment: 迷う心配はねぇな。\n 一気に突っ切るとすっか。

source: #325 Oh, yeah... Towa's been pretty\n worried about all of you, you know?
comment: そういえば、トワが君たちの事を\n ずいぶん心配していたよ。

source: #326 Well, I'm glad to know she's looking\n out for us.
comment: そうですか…有り難いな。

source: #327 Yeah. Though I feel a little bad,\n since we're making more work for her.
comment: いつもお世話になっていますし、\n 本当に頭が上がりませんね。

source: #328 We've been walking for ages.\n How far ARE we at this point?
comment: け、けっこう歩いたけど…\n どこまで来たんだろう。

source: #329 Judging by the distance we've traveled,\n I'd say we're about halfway.
comment: ん…歩数からすると\n 山道の半分くらいかな。

source: #330 H-How can you tell that...?
comment: す、凄いな。\n そんなことが分かるのか。

source: #331 This path's gotten real\n twisty all of a sudden.
comment: さっきから随分と\n 曲りくねってやがるな。

source: #332 Hmm... I wonder if they built it like\n that to avoid the mine shafts...
comment: ふむ、ひょっとしたら坑道を\n 避けて通っているのかもしれない。

source: #333 If that's true, that must\n mean we're almost there!
comment: そうなると、そろそろ\n 到着しそうですね…！

source: #334 Over there!
#335 Looks like we made it.
comment: よし、ゴールだな。

source: #336 Ahhhhhh... This is pure bliss. ㈱
comment: うーん、眼福、眼福㈱

source: #337 Stop that, Angelica!
comment: ア、アンゼリカさんっ…！

source: #338 Just kiddin' around. I love it\n when you're angry.
comment: 冗談だよ。\n 怒った顔も可愛いね。

source: #339 I swear, this girl...
comment: ったく、この女だけは…

source: #340 Looks like this place is crawling\n with archaisms, just like Garrelia.
comment: やはりガレリア要塞と同じように\n 人形兵器が放たれているようだな…

source: #341 There's some monsters I didn't see\n when we were here yesterday, too.
comment: 昨日は見かけなかった\n 魔獣もいるみたいだけど…

source: #342 They must have brought them in\n from outside. Be careful!
comment: 外から引き込んだのかもしれない。\n …気を引き締めて行こう！

source: #343 There's the exit. Looks like the\n gate's been shut.
comment: 鉱山の出口…\n ゲートが閉じてるね。

source: #344 So the provincial army and the RMP are\n having their shouting match out there...
comment: この向こうで、領邦軍と\n 鉄道憲兵隊が睨み合ってるのか…

source: #345 Let's just leave them to it.\n We need to head further in.
comment: こちらはいい。\n 奥に進むとしよう。

source: #346 Huh? A dead end?
comment: あれっ、行き止まり？

source: #347 Maybe not. We walked past\n a ladder not too long ago.
comment: いや、少し手前に\n 上に登る梯子があったはずだ。

source: #348 Let's go back and find it.
comment: 探してみましょう。

source: #349 Yep, this is the one. Climbing\n this should take us further in.
comment: うん、ここを登れば\n さらに奥まで行けるはずだ。

source: #350 ...There we go.
comment: ん…これでヨシ。

source: #351 Almost there... Just a little further now!
comment: 終点は近いわ…行きましょう！
その…リィンさん。

source: #353 Hold onto that thought for now.\n Let's just keep moving.
comment: 今はいいさ。\n とにかく先に進もう。
…はい！

source: #355 Meow.
comment: ニャア。

source: #356 Meeeow... Mrrowr.
comment: にゃああ…にゃおん。

source: #357 ...I know. I'll be careful, I promise.
comment: …分かってる。\n くれぐれも気をつけるから。

source: #358 (I always get this feeling like Emma\n can actually understand Celine...)
comment: （薄々気付いていたけど…\n  委員長、セリーヌと喋れるのか？）

source: #359 *hiss*
comment: ふしゃああ…

source: #360 This looks like...
comment: ここは…

source: #361 I can sense something inside.
comment: 気配を感じる…\n 何かがあるみたいですね。

source: #362 This looks like a nice spot.
comment: うん、ここなら釣れそうだな。

source: #363 Oooh, this looks like a good spot.
comment: おっ、いいポイントみたいだな。

source: #364 All right, let's get started.
comment: さあ、行きましょう。

source: #365 Looks like we've still got a ways to go.
comment: まだ先があるみたいね。

source: #366 Whew... This is the end.
comment: ふう、ここが終点ね。

source: #367 Ah! It's a treasure chest! ♪
comment: あ、宝箱発見♪

source: #368 That looks like a strong one...\n Be careful.
comment: 強そうね…注意しないと。

source: #369 What's that? It's so shiny...
comment: 何かしら…あの光ってるの…

source: #370 Onward!
comment: さあ、行くとしようか。

source: #371 Let's keep up the pace.
comment: うむ、この調子で進むとしよう。

source: #372 We appear to have reached the exit.
comment: フフ、どうやら終点のようだな。

source: #373 Is that a treasure chest?
comment: ふむ、宝箱か。

source: #374 A challenging foe. We should engage\n it with care.
comment: 難敵だな…心してかかるとしよう。

source: #375 What's that strange shining creature?
comment: むむっ…あの輝くモノは…

source: #376 Please be careful, everyone.
comment: 皆さん、気をつけて行きましょう。

source: #377 I wonder if we're around halfway\n through now.
comment: ようやく中間地点でしょうか…

source: #378 *sigh* It looks like we've\n finally made it to the end.
comment: はぁ、やっと終点みたいですね。

source: #379 Oh, that's a beautiful-looking\n treasure chest.
comment: あ、立派な宝箱です。

source: #380 This monster seems dangerous. Be careful!
comment: 危険度大…どうか気をつけて！

source: #381 Oh? I wonder what that strange\n glow is...
comment: あら、あの光っているのって…？

source: #382 Let's go.
comment: それじゃ、行こっか。

source: #383 We're still not done?\n *sigh* What a pain.
comment: まだあるのか…めんどいな。

source: #384 Oh, there's the end.
comment: ん、終点みたいだね。

source: #385 I spy treasure.
comment: お宝見っけ。

source: #386 That one looks annoying.\n Watch out.
comment: 厄介そう…気をつけた方がいいかも。

source: #387 So shiny... What is it?
comment: キラキラしてる…なんだろ？

source: #388 Let's go go gooo!
comment: さー、どんどん進んでいこう！

source: #389 Huh? There's more to go?
comment: んー、まだまだ続くみたいだねー。

source: #390 Oooh, this looks like the end!
comment: あ、ここが終点じゃない？

source: #391 Yaaay, treasure!
comment: お宝はっけーん！

source: #392 Oooh, that one looks tough.
comment: お、なかなか強そーだね。

source: #393 Whoa! Look at that shiny thing!
comment: わわっ、キラキラしてるのがいる！

source: #394 Let's go go gooo!
comment: さー、どんどん進んでいこう！

source: #395 Huh? There's more to go?
comment: んー、まだまだ続くみたいだねー。

source: #396 Oooh, this looks like the end!
comment: あ、ここが終点じゃない？

source: #397 Yaaay, treasure!
comment: お宝はっけーん！

source: #398 Oooh, that one looks tough.
comment: お、なかなか強そーだね。

source: #399 Whoa! Look at that shiny thing!
comment: わわっ、キラキラしてるのがいる！

source: #400 Let's be careful, everyone.
comment: よ、よーし、気をつけて行こう。

source: #401 Oh, boy... There's more?
comment: うう、まだ続いてるみたいだね…

source: #402 Yaaay! We're at the end!
comment: よかった～、終点みたいだ！

source: #403 Oh, a treasure chest!
comment: あ、宝箱だよ！

source: #404 That looks like a tough one.\n Be careful!
comment: 強そうなのがいる…気をつけないと。

source: #405 Whoa! What's that shiny thing?
comment: わわっ、あのキラキラしたのって…？

source: #406 All right, time to commence our\n investigation.
comment: さあ、探索を始めよう。
